title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: BayCare Sound, Clearwater | 2023
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at BayCare Sound at Coachman Park in Clearwater, Florida, USA, on 26 September 2023.

It was the 31st show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 43 dates between May and October 2023.

Starr returned to BayCare Sound on 21 June 2025.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
